artworks.title: Jason with the Golden Fleece
artworks.description: Thorvaldsen's neoclassical Jason — the son Alcimede bears to Aeson in Apollonius and Hyginus, the Minyan mother behind the Argonaut captain.

artworks.title: Medea Rejuvenates Aeson
artworks.description: Guidobono's Medea restoring Aeson — Alcimede's husband and Jason's father in the Argonaut genealogy that ties Iolcus to the Minyan line.
